method: For each source TRP P,Q verify Latin; compute Z[r,c]=index t with P[t,c]=Q[r,c]; verify Z Latin and overlay(Z,Q)=100; count common transversals by bitmask DFS and independent exhaustive 10! permutations; fewer than 10 implies no third square for that fixed pair.
independent_checks: Both algorithms agree for all six, full 10! enumeration each. GF4 positive control 16/16/16 locally.
compute: CPU only; six complete checks ~11.5 seconds total; no timeouts.
limitations: These are six specific published pairs, not all pairs of each Myrvold type, not a restricted-class proof, and not a global resolution. No SAT certificate or unrestricted symmetry coverage.
failures: Direct container PDF download failed due DNS; used web PDF text and rendered page images; manual transcription validated by independent Latin+overlay checks.
next_action: Explore Myrvold residual families beyond the eight published examples; prioritize source-generated diverse pairs and triple-aware constraints, or certificate-producing SAT for a rigorously scoped family.
